article.title: RWS推出Weava，把不同市場讀者的模擬評估加入翻譯流程
article.summary: RWS公布Weava，結合AI翻譯和模擬讀者評估，供企業處理多市場內容。
highlights: Audience Check可按指定讀者特徵指出疑點並提出修改。
團隊可設定品質門檻，需要額外判斷時交由人員處理。
article.why: 跨境品牌可比較譯文和本地審閱結果，保留需要人工決定的語氣與文化用詞。
article.next_step: 用同一段廣告文案比較兩個市場版本，列出語氣、稱謂及條款的審閱責任。
article.detail: RWS表示，Weava先按素材目的、受眾及品牌語氣整理要求，再由Language Weaver Pro翻譯。Audience Check用模擬讀者角色提出疑點和修改建議，平台可按品質門檻觸發修正，亦保留人員判斷。品牌可先用小批文案比較兩地編輯意見，記錄哪些建議可直接採用。
article.title_en: RWS launches Weava with simulated audience review in translation workflows
article.summary_en: RWS announced Weava, combining AI translation and simulated audience review for content across markets.
highlights_en: Audience Check uses defined reader profiles to flag issues and suggest changes.
Teams can configure quality thresholds and involve people where extra judgment is needed.
article.why_en: Cross-border teams can compare translations with local editorial feedback and retain human decisions on voice and culture.
article.next_step_en: Compare versions of the same ad in two markets and name reviewers for tone, forms of address and terms.
article.detail_en: RWS says Weava identifies content purpose, audience and brand voice before translation with Language Weaver Pro. Audience Check uses simulated reader profiles to suggest revisions. Configured thresholds can trigger corrections, with human judgment available. Use a small copy sample to compare feedback in two markets and record which suggestions reviewers accept.
